::: {#hero-heading}

I lead the BASE Lab at the University of Greenwich, where we develop autonomous X-ray imaging platforms for materials science. I am a Faraday Institution / STFC Emerging Leader Fellow, based jointly at Greenwich and the Rutherford Appleton Laboratory.

My research combines operando synchrotron experiments with AI and high-performance simulation. The current focus is on building self-driving microscopes that use physics-based digital twins to capture stochastic failure in batteries.

:::

## Facility Access

Principal Investigator on 9 experiments (~£1.7M in-kind value) at Diamond, ISIS, and Sirius, including the UK Battery Imaging BAG. Co-Investigator on 22 further experiments.

Invited to commission flagship instruments internationally: first external user of the MOGNO beamline (Sirius, Brazil), second external user of the dark-field X-ray microscope (ID03, ESRF), and second external user of the high-resolution neutron imaging beamline (PorTo, ILL).
